title: Cost-Effectiveness of Adjuvant Abemaciclib and Ribociclib in High-Risk Hormone Receptor-Positive Early Breast Cancer: An Indian Perspective.
authors: Sra, Manraj Singh; Sasi, Archana; Batra, Atul; Bakhshi, Sameer; Ganguly, Shuvadeep
one_liner_zh: 该文评估CDK4/6抑制剂在乳腺癌中的成本效益，与蛋白质-DNA互作及AI/物理模拟方法完全无关。
abstract: PURPOSE: Incorporating adjuvant cyclin-dependent kinase (CDK) 4/6 inhibitors abemaciclib and ribociclib along with endocrine therapy has been shown to improve invasive disease-free survival (iDFS) for hormone receptor-positive (HR+) human epidermal receptor 2-negative (HER2-) early breast cancer (EBC). This study assesses the cost-effectiveness of this strategy, along with adjuvant aromatase inhibitors from an Indian perspective. METHODS: A Markov chain model evaluated the cost-effectiveness of abemaciclib and ribociclib with letrozole compared with letrozole alone for HR+/HER2- EBC from a payer perspective in India. Key measures included lifetime quality-adjusted life-years (QALY), life-years (LY), and total costs. This study explores two scenarios for effectiveness: a best-case (BC) scenario, where the benefit of CDK4/6 inhibitors in improving iDFS lasts a lifetime, and a worst-case (WC) scenario, where benefits disappear after 5 years. Probabilistic sensitivity analyses (PSA) were used to account for simulation uncertainty. RESULTS: In the BC scenario, abemaciclib added 2.17 QALY and 4.96 LY, incurring ₹2,317,957.7 ($27,756.65 in US dollars [USD]) in additional costs. However, the incremental cost-effectiveness ratio (ICER) for abemaciclib exceeded India's willingness-to-pay threshold in the BC and WC scenarios. In the BC scenario, ribociclib added 0.98 QALY and 2.58 LY with added costs of ₹1,711,504.32 ($20,494.6 USD). The ICER for ribociclib also surpassed India's threshold in both scenarios. PSA showed that neither drug was cost-effective at the current market prices in either BC/WC scenario. The cost of abemaciclib and ribociclib needs to be reduced by at least 78.61% and 87.19%, respectively, to be cost-effective in the BC scenario. CONCLUSION: The combination of adjuvant abemaciclib or ribociclib with letrozole is not cost-effective for HR+/HER2- EBC in India in either the BC or WC scenario.
abstract_zh: 目的：辅助性细胞周期蛋白依赖性激酶（CDK）4/6抑制剂阿贝西利和瑞博西利联合内分泌治疗已被证明可改善激素受体阳性（HR+）人表皮生长因子受体2阴性（HER2-）早期乳腺癌（EBC）的无侵袭性疾病生存期（iDFS）。本研究从印度视角评估该策略以及辅助性芳香化酶抑制剂的成本效益。方法：采用马尔可夫链模型，从印度支付方视角评估阿贝西利和瑞博西利联合来曲唑与单独使用来曲唑治疗HR+/HER2- EBC的成本效益。主要指标包括终身质量调整生命年（QALY）、生命年（LY）和总成本。本研究探讨两种有效性情景：最佳情况（BC）情景，即CDK4/6抑制剂改善iDFS的获益持续终身；最差情况（WC）情景，即获益在5年后消失。采用概率敏感性分析（PSA）以考虑模拟不确定性。结果：在BC情景中，阿贝西利增加2.17 QALY和4.96 LY，产生额外成本₹2,317,957.7（美元[USD]27,756.65）。然而，在BC和WC情景中，阿贝西利的增量成本效益比（ICER）均超过印度的支付意愿阈值。在BC情景中，瑞博西利增加0.98 QALY和2.58 LY，额外成本为₹1,711,504.32（USD 20,494.6）。在两种情景中，瑞博西利的ICER也超过印度阈值。PSA显示，在当前市场价格下，两种药物在BC/WC情景中均不具有成本效益。在BC情景中，阿贝西利和瑞博西利的成本需分别降低至少78.61%和87.19%才能具有成本效益。结论：在印度，辅助性阿贝西利或瑞博西利联合来曲唑治疗HR+/HER2- EBC在BC或WC情景中均不具有成本效益。
